::api-operation{method="PUT" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/products/{prod}/applicable_plans"}
#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `prod` | `string` | **yes** | The product's id (a slug id, e.g. `pro`). |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plans` | `array of string` | **yes** | Plan product ids this add-on or charge is attached to. Replaces the whole link set — send the full list, not a delta. A charge needs a one-time price. |
| `applies_to_all` | `boolean` | no | Make this add-on applicable to EVERY plan (add-ons only). Omit to leave the flag unchanged; sending only `plans` never clears it. |
| `applicability` | `object` | no | Per-plan applicability level, keyed by plan id. Default `optional`. A charge is `mandatory` or `optional`, never `recommended`. |
| `config` | `object` | no | Per-plan charge semantics, keyed by plan id. Defaults: subscription_creation, charge_once=false, quantity=1, no billing-cycle cap. A charge is always charge_once and never cycle-capped. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `item` | `string` | The attached add-on or charge product |
| `applies_to_all` | `boolean` | True if the addon can attach to every plan. |
| `plans` | `array of string` | The ids of the plans the addon can attach to (a slug id, e.g. `pro`). |
| `applicability` | `object` | How each plan treats the addon. |
| `config` | `object` | Per-plan settings for the addon, keyed by plan id. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | Not an add-on or charge, a charge without a one-time price, or a bad plan |
| `404` | No such product |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X PUT "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/products/pro/applicable_plans" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "plans": [
      "pro"
    ]
  }'
```
